source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: ConfigVerifier.cleanup first checks pendingPrompts for the module’s login-origin/username key. It calls getAccessToken with both callback methods before cancelPrompt. OAuth2Module uses the same queue key and calls listener.onFailure on cancellation; MsgAsyncPrompter adds a same-key caller as a consumer and returns. This explains the matching-prompt cleanup and the concrete listener-stub repair. It is not proof of native protocol cancellation or that caught cleanup errors cannot leave state behind.
title: Verifier cleanup joins only a matching pending OAuth prompt with valid callbacks
